[Section] TweetQA
[source_id=10] In this section, we first describe the three-step data collection process of TweetQA: tweet crawling, question-answer writing and answer validation. Next, we define the specific task of TweetQA and discuss several evaluation metrics. To better understand the characteristics of the TweetQA task, we also include our analysis on the answer and question characteristics using a subset of QA pairs from the development set.
